correctness.rationale: The stable drift decouples exactly into sum and difference Ornstein–Uhlenbeck modes with independent decay rates but potentially correlated forcing. Their stationary second moments produce the full covariance and first-patch variance. A strictly increasing rational ratio controls the derivative sign, proving every boundary and the unique interior optimum. The isolated-value crossover factorization is direct. Exact symbolic reconstruction and 55,338 finite-rational assertions were run from the newly packaged code; the proof is analytical and covers all admissible parameters.

originality.rationale: A complete unequal-environmental-noise three-regime classification, its exact one-point optimum, and its two sharp independent-noise variance-contrast thresholds were not implied by the inspected papers. The directly relevant 2015 model fixes equal environmental noise variances; the 2011 analytical autoregression also fixes equal marginal variance. The generic Lyapunov method and the already known homogeneous-noise cancellation are explicitly excluded from the originality claim. Search completeness and an unread 2015 appendix remain stated risks.

value.rationale: Heterogeneous environmental fluctuation intensities and the local variance proxy are already motivated by stochastic metapopulation ecology. The result is a global, sharp, nontrivial trichotomy with a unique exact optimal migration rate, an independent-noise contrast threshold 5/3, and a separate 3 threshold for eventual instability relative to isolation. These distinguish local and aggregate stability and provide a model benchmark; no downstream or extinction-theorem significance is asserted.
